annotations.title: Code to check signups in your stack

description: Returns the steps and the copy-paste code that checks new signups with SignupBouncer in one stack: supabase (a hook, no code), ory (a web hook, no code), fetch (any TypeScript server), nextjs, express, hono, python, firebase or better-auth. Use it when the user asks for code that checks or blocks signups in their app. The code reads the API key from SIGNUPBOUNCER_API_KEY. The call has a 1.5-second limit, and any failure lets the signup through.
